review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–129). It declares no definitions, structures, classes or instances. It also has one local instance attribute, `attribute [local instance] Fintype.ofFinite`, which is Mathlib's own instance and not a competing one. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, and the file's theorems state the identity-coset case of operators defined elsewhere. I did not look at the upstream files that define the twisted slash sums, because the target file adds no concept that could compete with Mathlib. The only uncertainty is whether those upstream files duplicate Mathlib concepts, and that is outside this file.
